Introduction

Choi Seongyoon, popularly known as Y, is the main vocalist and visual of the boy group Golden Child under Woollim Entertainment. He originally joined Woollim in 2012 with the intention of becoming an actor but later changed his path and trained as a singer instead.

On December 27, Woollim announced on Weverse that the exclusive contracts of Golden Child members Lee Daeyeol, Y, Bae Seungmin, Bong Jaehyun, and Kim Donghyun would expire on December 31.
